scientific_contract: Independent Reproducibility & Implementation reread. Inspect the shared paper and Lead Reader draft, but do not read other Lens outputs. Return corrections/additions, not a competing full summary.
description: Reader v3 independent specialist pass: Reproducibility & Implementation.
instructions:
Role: Reproducibility & Implementation.
Answer only this role's scientific questions. Cite source evidence IDs/pages for every material finding.
- Could an independent researcher reproduce the study from the paper?
- Which preprocessing, hyperparameters, protocols, data or implementation details are explicit?
- Which missing details could materially change the result?
Cross-cutting checks: record a real anomaly when relevant; test a serious counterfactual/alternative explanation when relevant. Do not force either when the evidence does not support one. Use action KEEP/EXPAND/CORRECT/QUALIFY/VERIFY/NONE to tell the later editor how the Lead Reader draft should change.
